test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is incorrect?

(i) Zojila pass - The Great Himalayan range

(ii) Banihal pass - Pir Panjal range

(iii) Photu la pass - Zaskar range

(iv) Khardung la pass - Ladakh range
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. None of the above is incorrect. All match is correct**

 
• Kashmir or Northwestern Himalayas comprise a series of ranges such as the **Karakoram, Ladakh, Zaskar and Pir Panjal.**
 
• There are a number of passes in this region. They are:
 
• 
 
 
 

 **Pass**
 **Range**
 
 

 Zojila pass
 The Great Himalayan range
 
 

 Banihal pass
 Pir Panjal range
 
 

 Photu la pass
 Zaskar range
 
 

 Khardung la pass
 Ladakh range
